verified_sources.source_name: Jotun Global & Middle East Colour Trends 2026 / 2025
verified_sources.key_insights: Trending neutrals: Bare 1391, Breeze 0552, Macchiato 1359, Early Rain 0471, Timeless 1024, Space 10678, Smooth White 8470, Soft Touch 10290. RGB/NCS references and lighting undertones.

verified_sources.source_name: Kuwait Interior Design & Architecture Trend Report
verified_sources.key_insights: Kuwaiti modern villa preferences: Neutral warm greige for reception halls (Bare / Breeze), contrasting warm accents in majlis, avoiding yellow/green undertones under 3000K warm spot lighting, coordination with Kuwait travertine and light oak wood.

verified_sources.source_name: Shuwaikh & Hawally Jotun Authorised Dealership Sales Volume 2025-2026
verified_sources.key_insights: Highest requested tinting machine codes in Kuwait: Breeze (0552) for living halls, Bare (1391) for full-house cohesive flows, Skylight (1624) for ceilings, Cotton Ball (1453) for trims and moldings.
